text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, why did Sweep have to win?! Snatching 
Lord Teio's victory like that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmmm~!! Grrr! Jeez, and also, and also—!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you went and completely charmed 
my junior, too~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I think I'll just say that 
today, your running got everyone way more 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So thank you, Sweep. For giving me such a 
fun race.
